items.title: Japan's services inflation accelerates to 3.6pct in July, beating forecasts
items.summary: The upside surprise adds another data point to the case for a near term BOJ hike, arriving alongside already sharply shifted economist expectations for a September move to 1.25%. items.title: Preview, today: Fed's favoured inflation gauge lands two days before Warsh's Jackson Hole speech
items.summary: Today's PCE print carries added weight given its timing, landing just two days ahead of Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote and before Nvidia's earnings , making this a genuinely stacked stretch for US macro risk.
items.impactZh: 央行政策预期变化可能提升主要货币对波动，杠杆仓位的保证金与回撤压力上升。
items.impactEn: Shifts in central-bank expectations may increase major-pair volatility and raise margin/drawdown pressure on leveraged positions.
items.summaryZh: 鉴于其时机，今天的PCE印刷品增加了重量，仅比美联储主席沃什的首次杰克逊霍尔主题演讲提前两天，也比英伟达的盈利提前两天，这使得这对美国宏观风险来说是一个真正的累积延伸。
